what_happened: The Ezekiel orchestrator (claude-opus-5), directed by the owner in chat, wrote M8_fable continuation work all session, as earlier sessions of the marathon had. ACTIVE_WORKTREES.yaml names Fable 5 as the lane's only writer and records the one claude-opus-5 exception as exhausted, and M8_FABLE_RESUME_PROTOCOL.md says 'Only Fable 5 may write M8 continuation work.' The T1 distinct checker read the registry under its global policy and refused to write. That refusal is how the conflict surfaced.
containment: the running rulings lane (ezek_controlling_rulings_a1#e1) was stopped before it wrote anything, verified
no M8 write of any kind until the owner answered
no git operation, no registry edit, no deletion or quarantine

verified_state_at_hold.scoped_validator: status pass, no blocking failures (it does not check writer identity)

resolution: OW-11: the owner explicitly authorized this Opus 5 orchestration and its agents to write M8_fable work for Ezekiel and then Daniel, recorded in the M8 log only, with a combined 15M ceiling. authorization_ref lowell_chat_2026-09-10_m8_opus_orchestration_ezek_dan
root_cause: Resume checks were the scoped validator, HEAD equal to remote, and the probe. The validator passes owner-scoped uncommitted work without checking which identity wrote it, and the resume generator never carried the registry's owner-identity rule. So the one rule that decides whether a session may write was never read at resume.
sibling_paths: Earlier sessions of this marathon share the same root cause; their M8 work was owner-directed in chat and is not reopened by this finding.
controls: canonical resume clause: before the first M8 write, read the active-worktree registry's owner and identity rule for the lane
subagents write deliverables outside the worktree; the authorized orchestrator lands them
close-gate item 15; checker v3.3 paired clauses bind OW-11's scope and expiry wherever the exception is cited
regression_test: _safe_to_clear_check.py --selftest fixtures: a prompt that continues into Daniel without the stop at Daniel's close fails; a prompt that cites the exception without its expiry fails
prevention_skill: declined by the owner for now (OW-11 answer 'Not now'); lesson recorded in the ledger and in campaign memory
